reviews.text: It was my first time at the new location and it is been maybe two years since i had my last chicken corano sandwich. It was amazing, maybe better. This sandwich is highly recommended. The new place is way much better than the old one. The staff is friendly and welcoming, you feel at home. One thing, the order took around 20 minutes, except of that all is good. I saw the cutest cat outside the restaurant.
reviews.author: Rima issa
Eli Doueri
reviews.text:
Second time hitting up this spot—locals sent me here like it was a hidden gem, and turns out, they knew what they were talking about. It’s a good, honest, family-run place, and you can feel they actually care about their customers—not just serving food, but serving it right.
I tried the chicken sandwiches and the burgers. Verdict? Solid.Nothing fancy, just real, tasty food done properly.
Definitely worth checking out. Good people, good food, no regrets.
